items.summary: No new CRO admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 43 improvements measuring and 21 failed requests. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z, then release one slot for the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement. Baseline: 61 registered affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Measure registered affiliate clicks only; revenue, ROI, and causal lift remain unknown.

Use the existing queued request; do not duplicate it. Prototype scope: improve CTA hierarchy and disclosure placement on the highest-intent merchandising surface while preserving destinations and registered tracking IDs. Acceptance: destination resolution, tracking-ID match, disclosure visibility, keyboard/mobile accessibility, build/link checks, and single-diff rollback. Measurement: 14 days or 100 relevant new impressions/clicks, using registered affiliate clicks as the primary metric. Do not add telemetry, change credentials, spend, or alter launch/security gates.

Retain three research-backed opportunities without prototype admission until capacity and security gates clear. MarkItDown (MIT; lab passed 8/8 bounded checks) could normalize source documents into draft SEO/content inputs; smallest prototype is a disposable-workspace batch over existing non-production documents, measured by valid draft acceptance rate and editor time. Risks: parser coverage, malformed or adversarial files, dependency provenance, and no production adoption without CTO/security review. shadcn/ui (MIT; lab passed 3/3) could standardize accessible conversion components; smallest prototype is one isolated component rendered against an existing site fixture, measured by accessibility/build pass rate and CTA interaction proxy, not revenue. Risks: framework/runtime compatibility, styling drift, dependency maintenance, and supply-chain review. Mermaid (MIT; lab fit supported, no native checks) could add structured diagrams to high-intent guides; smallest prototype is one static diagram in a disposable preview, measured by render stability and page engagement proxy. Risks: client-side payload, accessibility/SEO semantics, rendering security, and unsupported causal lift. These remain research-only and must not be queued this cycle.

Do not admit new CRO, site-factory, telemetry, or duplicate queue work while all ten delivery slots are occupied. Existing revenue evidence is limited to $4.92 aggregate unattributed Amazon commission for 2026-09-21; no site-level revenue, margin, ROI, payback, or causal-lift claim is supported. Keep private-launch and security-sensitive release gates unchanged.
